title.v: Danh sách tổng hợp phiếu chi

query.text: declare @key2 nvarchar(3000), @Update nvarchar(4000) select @key2 = @lookupKey + case when @val = '' then '' else ' and (@@fieldKey like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@val) + '%'' or @@fieldName like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@val) + '%'')' end set @Update = 'update #v set da_pb_nt = b.tt_nt from #v a join (select ma_kh, ma_nt, id, sum(tt_nt) as tt_nt from ctct20 where loai_tt = 1 and id in (select id from #v) group by ma_kh, ma_nt, id) b on a.id = b.id and a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh and a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt' set @Update = @Update + ' update #v set cl_nt=tien_nt-da_pb_nt ' set @Update = @Update + ' delete #v where cl_nt = 0 ' exec ISWIFTStoreTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh', 'b.ten_kh', N'@@key', @key2, @@filterKey, @Update, @pageIndex, 10, @@admin, @@userId
